course.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: The stress intensity for a partial-through thickness flaw is given by $\mathrm { K } = \sigma \sqrt { \pi a } \sqrt { s \mathrm { e c } \frac { \pi a } { 2 t } }$ where ‘a' is the depth of penetration of the flaw through a wall thickness t. If the flaw is 5mm deep in a wall 12mm thick, determine whether the wall will support a stress of 172 MPa if it is made from 7075-T6 aluminium alloy. Fracture toughness of 7075-T6 aluminium alloy is $2 4 \mathrm { M P a } \sqrt { m }$
